Subject: Payout withheld for Nov — need per-day metering & tariff docs

Hi Aditya,

Finance paused our November marketplace payout after the GCP ingest showed multiple entries flagged under a recently reclassified tariff. They need per-day metering breaks and the original invoice mapping to release the hold. Our billing team also wants any tax/VAT evidence you have that explains why certain entries were zero-rated vs. standard GST.

Can you provide: 
- Per-day metering export for 2026-11-01 — 2026-11-30 (UTC timestamps)
- Mapping from marketplace usage IDs to Redwood invoice lines
- Any formal note explaining the tariff reclassification (if Redwood changed classification or if GCP flagged it)

We need this by COB Monday PST to avoid payment aging. If you prefer, we can jump on a 30-min call — propose Mon 10am PT.

Thanks,
Claire

Claire — quick technical note: 

We deployed an entity/SKU remap on 2026-11-28 to collapse a legacy subscription SKU into the new unified SKU. That remap caused a minority of usage rows to be reclassified by GCP's downstream processing as a different tariff bucket — effectively a label change, not a change to how tokens were billed.

I'm preparing a delta report that shows pre-/post-remap usage_id -> sku mapping for the affected 412 rows. I'll hand that to Laura to include in the invoice-line mapping.

If BrightMetrics needs the raw usage IDs and the exact kernel (model+profile) name for each row, say the word and I'll export the payloads.
